description: List Shroom Labs mushroom grow profiles (species and strains such as lion's mane, pearl oyster, shiitake). Each has a slug for get_profile, total grow days and a canonical URL. Culinary only by default; set include_off_menu to also list educational Off-menu profiles (always returned with a legal notice).

include_off_menu.description: Also include educational Off-menu profiles. Default false.

query.description: Optional filter on name, species or tag, e.g. 'oyster' or 'beginner'.

name: list_profiles
title: List mushroom grow profiles
